text:
Location: Ton Son Nhut in front of our hooch
The other Unit is somewhere in the background, the guy that did the shooting in the bathroom. They had just arrived maybe a week or so. The photo would probably be July of 1965. I got the camera about 3-weeks into Vietnam which would have been Oct of 1964.
